mood: Radiant and absurdly cheerful: a golden temple above the clouds, grinning in the sunrise.

shape.borderStyle: 3px solid #9A5E0F with a light gold inner bevel

buttonStyle: Primary is a gold gradient button with dark brown Cinzel text and a brown outline that glows on hover; secondary is a cream button with a gold outline.
backdrop: Warm gold sky gradient with pale rays radiating from a smiley sun, rotating once every few minutes, and a cloud bank at the bottom that drifts sideways slowly.
motion: Gentle, slow drifts only; nothing flashes or pulses faster than once per second (WCAG 2.3.1), and all ambient motion stops when the user picks reduced motion.
